response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and distributed systems expertise with exposure to AI-agent infrastructure, but lacks direct executive leadership experience in fintech or regulated environments. His background in agentic frameworks and real-time systems is promising, though not explicitly tied to financial applications or multi-agent production deployments at scale.
strengths: Hands-on experience with AI-agent infrastructure (e.g., MCP code generators, agentic workflows at re:cinq)
Deep expertise in event-driven architectures and distributed systems (e.g., micro-services at Sociomantic, GISCollective)
Proven track record of technical leadership in scaling engineering practices (e.g., TDD, CI/CD, observability)
concerns: No explicit executive leadership experience (e.g., CTO, VP Engineering) in high-growth or regulated environments
Limited demonstrated impact in fintech-specific domains (e.g., credit systems, real-time risk modeling)
Agentic AI experience appears more tooling-focused than core architectural design for financial decisioning
